references.text: The introduction to the entire section on forbidden sexual relations, which establishes the general principle of not exposing shame among close relatives.
The penalty for sexual intercourse with a daughter-in-law is death for both parties. This verse gives the punishment for violating the prohibition in Lev 18:15.
The account of Judah and Tamar, his daughter-in-law, which serves as an example from the patriarchal period of a situation involving sexual relations between a father-in-law and his daughter-in-law.
Ezekiel condemns those who have done shameful things with their daughters-in-law, as part of the listing of Israel's sins.
